text_block_list.text:
On the way back. Since she had fallen 
asleep and couldn't play last time, we 
decided to stop by the park per her 
request.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay! We're gonna play sooooo much 
today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do! The spiral slide 
sounds great too~~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Slick slides are awesome too~! Alrighty, 
here I gooo~!!

Saying that, she dashed off toward the 
playground equipment.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It slides super fast! Again! Again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Awesome, it's like a tunnel! 
Vrrroooom!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Ahaha! This is so fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Aren't you playing, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come play with us~! It's super fun~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You really don't have to hold back, 
you know!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! You can choose what we play, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Then... I want to ride the swings.
Go have fun, I'll be watching.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The swings?! Sure! I love the swings too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's see whose is taller!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeei! Uryaaaaaah! There's no way, no way 
I'm gonna loseeee!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh!? Trainer, that's all!?

Fearing it might break if an adult pedaled 
at full strength, they pedaled with very 
little force.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, then I win this match~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, you were great too! I 
think you worked super hard! Yep!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll teach you the trick next time!

As she thumped her chest reassuringly, I 
felt how much she had grown and headed on 
the way home.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Just because you're an adult doesn't mean 
you have to hold back!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Papa and Mama were going down the slides 
with me too, so it's totally fine!

And so, I was dragged all the way to the 
slide.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come on, give it a slide! It's super fun!
(Swooooooooosh)

A wave of nostalgia washes over me at the 
familiar sensation of sliding down in the 
blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah! Looking good, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, I'm gonna slide too! Watch 
me, Trainer!!

I politely declined the invitations that 
followed, and watched her play for a 
while.
